descriptor.scene: A RETURNED FOUNDER TEACHING is the subject. CHRISSY stands at the whiteboard at frame RIGHT in her cream blazer, mid-sentence, marker raised toward a hand-drawn rising curve on the board, her face open and animated. Facing her, five newer founders sit on mismatched chairs, backs and three-quarter profiles to camera. Among them MAYA (sage-olive blazer) takes notes, and GARY (light-wash denim jacket, yellow smiley patch on the left chest, orange pixel-mascot patch on the right chest) sits at the edge of the group, listening rather than leading. Warm afternoon light through the big windows. The whiteboard carries only simple hand-drawn curves and boxes, no readable words.
descriptor._caption: The ones who flew keep coming back. They stand where they once sat, and they hand down what the climb taught them. In most industries the winners hoard altitude. In this room, altitude is the thing you owe the next batch.
